description: The Codebelt.Extensions.Xunit namespace contains types that provides a uniform way of doing unit testing. The namespace relates to the Xunit.Abstractions namespace.
releaseNotes:
Version: 13.0.0
Availability: .NET 11, .NET 10 and .NET Standard 2.0

# ALM
- CHANGED Target frameworks by adding .NET 11 (net11.0) and removing .NET 9 (net9.0), so the package now targets .NET 11, .NET 10 and .NET Standard 2.0

# Breaking Changes
- .NET 9 consumers must target .NET 10 or later.

# Features
- ADDED PriorityAttribute and PriorityTestMethodOrderer for ordering xUnit v3 test methods by numeric priority.
